title: Hayden Cade Return Filing stays listed with no authored choice after Wolf-Winter
body:
After **Wolf-Winter completes**, Albany Station still lists **Hayden’s Cade Return Filing** with “No authored choice is currently available in this journey state.”

This 200-player grok-4.6 (low) MCP wave (build `36ff6d106fa0df2ff19e80d09cf00df081b81653`, seed-base `1900000000`): **41** reports in ticket `2df266d25f7cc893` (S1) — the single highest-count cluster in the wave. Example seeds: `1900000041`, `1900000074`, `1900000158`, `1900000161`. Example record: `3bd835d2a983970e57e828ac40dfcb1b8c93c0de9038cd6c3ba552885dab5b03`.

Fix: when Wolf-Winter is complete, either author the Hayden filing choice or hide/close that lead. If it must stay visible, replace the engine sentence with world-facing copy instead of “authored choice / journey state.”
area: Albany Station Hayden Cade Return Filing

evidence.summary: Grok-4.6 low MCP 200-wave ticket 2df266d25f7cc893 (41 S1 reports) on build 36ff6d10.
